Tom / procurement —

Please find the evidence checklist below (attached version sent as PDF):
- SOC2: control matrix and sample evidence (config screenshots, runbooks)
- Log retention: default 90 days for hosted; configurable for Dedicated/Private (we include 365-day option via add-on)
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) in Private and Dedicated deployments
- Data residency: we can restrict region to US-West or EU regions depending on contract; Private deployments support on-prem air-gapped installs per the MAP

Also confirming Dedicated capacity can be included in a 12-mo committed contract; we’ll include migration credits and an option to transition to Private if needed. Karthik will provide the exact committed compute units and pricing line items.

Attachments: SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf (evidence checklist)

Thanks,
Kimberly
